methods.name: public abstract boolean canHandle(@NonNull Object transition)
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if this implementation can handle the specified {@link transition}.

methods.name: public abstract Object cloneTransition(@Nullable Object transition)
methods.comment: * Returns a clone of a transition or null if it is null

methods.name: public abstract Object wrapTransitionInSet(@Nullable Object transition)
methods.comment:
* Wraps a transition in a TransitionSet and returns the set. If transition is null, null is
     * returned.

methods.name: public abstract void setSharedElementTargets(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @NonNull View nonExistentView, @NonNull ArrayList<View> sharedViews)
methods.comment:
* Finds all children of the shared elements and sets the wrapping TransitionSet
     * targets to point to those. It also limits transitions that have no targets to the
     * specific shared elements. This allows developers to target child views of the
     * shared elements specifically, but this doesn't happen by default.

methods.name: public abstract void setEpicenter(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @Nullable View view)
methods.comment: * Sets a transition epicenter to the rectangle of a given View.

methods.name: protected void getBoundsOnScreen(View view, Rect epicenter)
methods.comment:
* Replacement for view.getBoundsOnScreen because that is not public. This returns a rect
     * containing the bounds relative to the screen that the view is in.

methods.name: public abstract void addTargets(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @NonNull ArrayList<View> views)
methods.comment:
* This method adds views as targets to the transition, but only if the transition
     * doesn't already have a target. It is best for views to contain one View object
     * that does not exist in the view hierarchy (state.nonExistentView) so that
     * when they are removed later, a list match will suffice to remove the targets.
     * Otherwise, if you happened to have targeted the exact views for the transition,
     * the replaceTargets call will remove them unexpectedly.

methods.name: public abstract Object mergeTransitionsTogether(@Nullable Object transition1, @Nullable Object transition2, @Nullable Object transition3)
methods.comment:
* Creates a TransitionSet that plays all passed transitions together. Any null
     * transitions passed will not be added to the set. If all are null, then an empty
     * TransitionSet will be returned.

methods.name: public abstract void scheduleHideFragmentView(@NonNull Object exitTransitionObj, @NonNull View fragmentView, @NonNull ArrayList<View> exitingViews)
methods.comment:
* After the transition completes, the fragment's view is set to GONE and the exiting
     * views are set to VISIBLE.

methods.name: public abstract Object mergeTransitionsInSequence(@Nullable Object exitTransitionObj, @Nullable Object enterTransitionObj, @Nullable Object sharedElementTransitionObj)
methods.comment:
* Combines enter, exit, and shared element transition so that they play in the proper
     * sequence. First the exit transition plays along with the shared element transition.
     * When the exit transition completes, the enter transition starts. The shared element
     * transition can continue running while the enter transition plays.
     *
     * @return A TransitionSet with all of enter, exit, and shared element transitions in
     * it (modulo null values), ordered such that they play in the proper sequence.

methods.name: public abstract void beginDelayedTransition(@NonNull ViewGroup sceneRoot, @Nullable Object transition)
methods.comment: * Calls {@code TransitionManager#beginDelayedTransition(ViewGroup, Transition)}.

methods.name: public boolean isSeekingSupported()
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if the Transition is seekable.

methods.name: public boolean isSeekingSupported(@NonNull Object transition)
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if the Transition is seekable.

methods.name: public Object controlDelayedTransition(@NonNull ViewGroup sceneRoot, @NonNull Object transition)
methods.comment: * Allows for controlling a seekable transition

methods.name: public void setCurrentPlayTime(@NonNull Object transitionController, float progress)
methods.comment: * Uses given progress to set the current play time of the transition.

methods.name: public void animateToEnd(@NonNull Object transitionController)
methods.comment: * Animate the transition to end.

methods.name: public void animateToStart(@NonNull Object transitionController, @NonNull Runnable completeRunnable)
methods.comment: * Animate the transition to start.

methods.name: ArrayList<String> prepareSetNameOverridesReordered(ArrayList<View> sharedElementsIn)
methods.comment:
* Prepares for setting the shared element names by gathering the names of the incoming
     * shared elements and clearing them. {@link #setNameOverridesReordered(View, ArrayList,
     * ArrayList, ArrayList, Map)} must be called after this to complete setting the shared element
     * name overrides. This must be called before
     * {@link #beginDelayedTransition(ViewGroup, Object)}.

methods.name: void setNameOverridesReordered(final View sceneRoot, final ArrayList<View> sharedElementsOut, final ArrayList<View> sharedElementsIn, final ArrayList<String> inNames, final Map<String, String> nameOverrides)
methods.comment:
* Changes the shared element names for the incoming shared elements to match those of the
     * outgoing shared elements. This also temporarily clears the shared element names of the
     * outgoing shared elements. Must be called after
     * {@link #beginDelayedTransition(ViewGroup, Object)}.

methods.name: public abstract void scheduleRemoveTargets(@NonNull Object overallTransitionObj, @Nullable Object enterTransition, @Nullable ArrayList<View> enteringViews, @Nullable Object exitTransition, @Nullable ArrayList<View> exitingViews, @Nullable Object sharedElementTransition, @Nullable ArrayList<View> sharedElementsIn)
methods.comment:
* After the transition has started, remove all targets that we added to the transitions
     * so that the transitions are left in a clean state.

methods.name: public void setListenerForTransitionEnd(@NonNull final Fragment outFragment, @NonNull Object transition, androidx.core.os.@NonNull CancellationSignal signal, @NonNull Runnable transitionCompleteRunnable)
methods.comment:
* Set a listener for Transition end events. The default behavior immediately completes the
     * transition.
     *
     * @param outFragment The first fragment that is exiting
     * @param transition all transitions to be executed on a single container
     * @param signal used indicate the desired behavior on transition cancellation
     * @param transitionCompleteRunnable used to notify the FragmentManager when a transition is
     *                                   complete

methods.name: public void setListenerForTransitionEnd(@NonNull final Fragment outFragment, @NonNull Object transition, androidx.core.os.@NonNull CancellationSignal signal, @Nullable Runnable cancelRunnable, @NonNull Runnable transitionCompleteRunnable)
methods.comment:
* Set a listener for Transition end events. The default behavior immediately completes the
     * transition.
     *
     * Use this when the given transition is seeking. The cancelRunnable should handle
     * cleaning up the transition when seeking is cancelled.
     *
     * If the transition is not seeking, you should use
     * {@link #setListenerForTransitionEnd(Fragment, Object, androidx.core.os.CancellationSignal, Runnable)}.
     *
     * @param outFragment The first fragment that is exiting
     * @param transition all transitions to be executed on a single container
     * @param signal used indicate the desired behavior on transition cancellation
     * @param cancelRunnable runnable to handle the logic when the signal is cancelled
     * @param transitionCompleteRunnable used to notify the FragmentManager when a transition is
     *                                   complete

methods.name: public abstract void swapSharedElementTargets(@Nullable Object sharedElementTransitionObj, @Nullable ArrayList<View> sharedElementsOut, @Nullable ArrayList<View> sharedElementsIn)
methods.comment:
* Swap the targets for the shared element transition from those Views in sharedElementsOut
     * to those in sharedElementsIn

methods.name: public abstract void replaceTargets(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @SuppressLint("UnknownNullness") ArrayList<View> oldTargets, @SuppressLint("UnknownNullness") ArrayList<View> newTargets)
methods.comment:
* This method removes the views from transitions that target ONLY those views and
     * replaces them with the new targets list.
     * The views list should match those added in addTargets and should contain
     * one view that is not in the view hierarchy (state.nonExistentView).

methods.name: public abstract void addTarget(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @NonNull View view)
methods.comment: * Adds a View target to a transition. If transitionObj is null, nothing is done.

methods.name: public abstract void removeTarget(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @NonNull View view)
methods.comment: * Remove a View target to a transition. If transitionObj is null, nothing is done.

methods.name: public abstract void setEpicenter(@NonNull Object transitionObj, @NonNull Rect epicenter)
methods.comment:
* Sets the epicenter of a transition to a rect object. The object can be modified until
     * the transition runs.

methods.name: protected static void bfsAddViewChildren(final List<View> views, final View startView)
methods.comment:
* Uses a breadth-first scheme to add startView and all of its children to views.
     * It won't add a child if it is already in views or if it has a transition name.

methods.name: private static boolean containedBeforeIndex(final List<View> views, final View view, final int maxIndex)
methods.comment: * Does a linear search through views for view, limited to maxIndex.

methods.name: protected static boolean isNullOrEmpty(List list)
methods.comment: * Simple utility to detect if a list is null or has no elements.
